args.title: Issue 4402: change src/util/money.ts
args.body:
File: src/util/money.ts

The src/util/money.ts file's parseAmount function removes a fixed set of currency symbols but does not handle the Indian rupee symbol or other international currency prefixes leading to the 'The amount is not a number' error. It needs to be updated to accept the rupee sign and other relevant symbols to fix the issue.
